title: security: rbac-v2 - enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: tighten RBAC v2 so KMS keys and region residency constraints are consistently enforced and fully auditable across hosted/dedicated/private modes. This PR: 1) Adds enforcement layer that validates KMS key region against the dataset/route residency policy at request admission time; 2) Enhances audit logging to include pre/post enforcement decision payloads and KMS key fingerprints; 3) Introduces a compatibility flag (rbac.v2.kms_enforcement=enabled|audit-only) and migration utility to convert existing policy bindings; 4) Adds unit and integration tests, and updates docs and Linear tickets. Checklist: - [x] Add server-side enforcement check and policy evaluation path - [x] Emit structured audit events with KMS key metadata - [x] Add migration tool + CLI docs - [x] Add unit tests and integration test harness (local and canary) - [x] Run CI and fix flakey tests - [x] Update runtime feature flag gating and rollout plan Related: ENG-7821, SEC-190, SUP-4521. Notes: The enforcement is opt-in via config and defaults to audit-only for 2 weeks post-merge before org rollout; all audit events include request_id, principal_id, policy_id, kms_key_fingerprint, region, decision, and rule_matches. Development/Testing: validated against local private-installer and redwood-dedicated cluster in staging. Migration: included a small migration CLI (rbac-migrate kms-region-pin) which scans bindings and suggests changes; operator approval required to flip enforcement to enabled.

release_notes: Enhancement: RBAC v2 now supports opt-in enforcement of KMS region pinning with enhanced audit logging and migration tooling. This ships as audit-only by default; operators should run the included migration tool and follow the docs to enable enforcement. See docs/security/rbac_v2_kms.md for rollout and private-installer guidance.
